# ProcessResult

**Class** · `ironwood.process.ProcessResult`

```java
public final class ProcessResult
```

How a program launched by [`ProcessRunner`](ProcessRunner.md) ended. It holds only
primitive status, never a live process or stream handle.


## Member summary

[Methods](#methods)

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`exitValue()`](#member-exitValue-28--29-) | Returns the exit status as Java's `Process.exitValue()` reports it on POSIX hosts: the program's exit status, or 128 plus the signal number when a signal ended it. |
| [`signaled()`](#member-signaled-28--29-) | Tells whether a signal ended the program, which distinguishes it from a program that exits with a value above 128 itself. |
| [`signal()`](#member-signal-28--29-) | Returns the number of the signal that ended the program. |
